knowledge:
- key_parameters: aucMaxRank=The maximum rank used to calculate the AUC (default is 5% of the total number of genes). Increase this threshold for datasets where cells express many genes or have high expression values ;; plotStats=Logical parameter in AUCell_buildRankings; if TRUE, plots the distribution of the number of genes detected per cell to help choose the aucMaxRank threshold ;; assign=Logical parameter in AUCell_exploreThresholds; if TRUE, returns the list of cells passing the calculated thresholds ;; BPPARAM=Parallel execution parameter (e.g., BiocParallel::MulticoreParam(5)) to speed up execution on large datasets
- alternatives: Mean expression of gene signature=Calculating the average expression of a signature on raw counts. This requires library-size normalization because cells with more reads will naturally have higher average values. AUCell is preferred because it evaluates cells individually, making it independent of normalization and library size
- when_to_use: When identifying specific cell types or active gene modules in single-cell RNA-seq data without relying on gene expression units or normalization procedures, especially in large datasets where cells can be processed individually
- pitfalls: Zero-expression genes=Genes with expression '0' are randomly sorted at the end of the ranking. Ensure most cells have at least the number of detected genes specified by aucMaxRank ;; Threshold selection=The automatic threshold selection in AUCell_exploreThresholds is not exhaustive; users must manually inspect AUC histograms and adjust thresholds if necessary ;; Dataset merging=Rankings can be merged across datasets only if the datasets have similar sensitivity (number of detected genes) and use the same gene IDs ;; Gene set size=Small gene sets (<100 genes) are prone to random AUC fluctuations (e.g., AUC = 0 or high AUC by chance), whereas larger gene sets (100-2000 genes) are more stable

workflows.name: aucell_gene_set_enrichment
workflows.intent: Identify cells with active gene signatures in single-cell RNA-seq data by building expression rankings, calculating AUC enrichment, and determining assignment thresholds.
input: exprMatrix (Single-cell expression matrix with genes as rows and cells as columns, ideally in sparse dgCMatrix format)
geneSets (GeneSetCollection or list containing the gene signatures to evaluate)
workflows.stages: 1. Convert expression matrix to sparse format ;; 2. Filter gene sets to match genes present in the expression matrix using subsetGeneSets ;; 3. Build gene-expression rankings for each cell using AUCell_buildRankings ;; 4. Calculate enrichment for the gene signatures using AUCell_calcAUC ;; 5. Determine cell assignment thresholds using AUCell_exploreThresholds ;; 6. Plot AUC histograms and visualize active cells on t-SNE using AUCell_plotHist and AUCell_plotTSNE
workflows.code:
library(Matrix)
exprMatrix <- as(exprMatrix, "dgCMatrix")

library(AUCell)
library(GSEABase)
geneSets <- subsetGeneSets(geneSets, rownames(exprMatrix))
geneSets <- setGeneSetNames(geneSets, newNames=paste(names(geneSets), " (", nGenes(geneSets) ,"g)", sep=""))

cells_rankings <- AUCell_buildRankings(exprMatrix, plotStats=TRUE)

cells_AUC <- AUCell_calcAUC(geneSets, cells_rankings)

set.seed(333)
par(mfrow=c(3,3)) 
cells_assignment <- AUCell_exploreThresholds(cells_AUC, plotHist=TRUE, assign=TRUE)

geneSetName <- rownames(cells_AUC)[grep("Oligodendrocyte_Cahoy", rownames(cells_AUC))]
AUCell_plotHist(cells_AUC[geneSetName,], aucThr=0.25)
abline(v=0.25)

selectedThresholds <- getThresholdSelected(cells_assignment)
selectedThresholds[2] <-  0.25
par(mfrow=c(2,3))
AUCell_plotTSNE(tSNE=cellsTsne, exprMat=exprMatrix, cellsAUC=cells_AUC[1:2,], thresholds=selectedThresholds)
